description: A slider on the native range input, so its keyboard (arrows, Page Up and Down, Home, End) and screen reader support stay: one thumb, or two on one track for a span such as a price range. Min, max and step, a prefix or suffix on the value shown beside the label and read out per thumb, in the page's number format. Range values submit as name[] and bind with wire:model. Right to left fills from the right.
